image_description: A close-up shot of a baby wearing a black bib with white trim. The bib features two distinct printed graphics: a yellow/green textured figure on the left and a photorealistic face of a person wearing a crown on the right. The baby is holding the straps of the bib near their neck. The background is a plain white sheet or fabric.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The graphic of the face with the crown exhibits hyper-realism that clashes with the stylized yellow figure on the left. The skin texture on the printed face looks unnaturally smooth and 'waxy,' typical of AI-generated faces pasted onto objects.

The baby's mouth area is distorted. The lips are asymmetrical and seem to merge slightly with the surrounding skin. The teeth/gums area is indistinct and malformed, lacking clear anatomical definition.
The fingers holding the bib straps lack clear separation. The edges of the fingers bleed into the white straps and the black bib material, making the grip look physically implausible.
There is a white tag on the left strap with markings that resemble text but are illegible and nonsensical, a common artifact in AI generation.
